Ecclesie Thessalonicensium in Deo Patre: to the church of the Thessalonians, in God the Father
GRATIA VOBIS ET PAX: Grace be to you and peace
semper pro omnibus vobis, memoriam vestr: always for you all; making a remembrance of you
operis fidei vestre: of the work of your faith
Domini nostri Iesu Christi ante Deum: of our Lord Jesus Christ before God and our Father
fratres dilecti a Deo electionem vestram: brethren beloved of God, your election
quia evangelium nostrum non fuit ad vos: For our gospel hath not been unto you in word only
scitis quales fuerimus: as you know what manner of men we have been
QUALES FUERIMUS PROPTER VOS: what manner of men we have been for your sakes
Et vos imitatores nostri facti estis: And you became followers of us
IMITATORES NOSTRI ET DOMINI: followers of us and of the Lord
cum gaudio Spiritus sancti,: with joy of the Holy Ghost
ita ut facti sitis forma omnibus credent: So that you were made a pattern to all that believe
enim diffamatus est sermo Domini, non so: For from you was spread abroad the word of the Lord, not only in Macedonia, and in Achaia, but also in every place
que est ad Deum profecta est, ita ut non: which is towards God, is gone forth, so that we need not
introitum habuerimus ad vos, et quomodo: what manner of entering in we had unto you; and how
SERVIRE DEO VIVO ET VERO: to serve the living and true God
et exspectare Filium eius de celis: and to wait for his Son from heaven
who delivered us from the wrath to come
Nam ipsi scitis, fratres, introitum nost: For yourselves know, brethren, our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain
fiduciam habuimus in Deo nostro: we had confidence in our God
loqui ad vos evangelium Dei in multa sol: to speak unto you the gospel of God in much carefulness
enim nostra non de errore,: For our exhortation was not of error
sed sicut probati sumus a Deo ut credere: But as we were approved by God that the gospel should be committed
evangelium, ita loquimur non quasi homin: the gospel: even so we speak, not as pleasing men
Neque enim aliquando fuimus in sermone a: For neither have we used, at any time, the speech of flattery
ut Christi apostoli, sed: as the apostles of Christ: but
cupide volebamus tradere vobis non solum: we would gladly impart unto you not only the gospel of God
because you were become most dear unto us
Memores enim estis fratres laboris nostr: For you remember, brethren, our labour and toil
ne quem vestrum gravaremus,: lest we should be chargeable to any of you
we preached among you the gospel of God
Vos testes estis et Deus, quam sancte: You are witnesses, and God also, how holily
vobis qui credidistis affuimus,: we have been to you that have believed
qualiter unumquemque vestrum tamquam pat: in what manner, as a father doth his children
et nos non solum vosgratias agimus Deo: we also give thanks to God
sine intermissione, quoniam cum accepiss: without ceasing: because, that when you had received of us the word of the hearing
accepistis illud non ut verbum hominum,: you received it not as the word of men
sed sicut est verbum Dei qui: but (as it is indeed) the word of God, who
SICUT EST VERBUM DEI: As it is indeed the word of God
imitatores facti estis fratres Ecclesiar: are become followers of the churches of God which are in Judea, in Christ Jesus
quia eadem passi estis: for you also have suffered the same things
et vos a contribulibus vestris, sicut et: from your own countrymen, even as they have from the Jews

persecuti sunt, et Deo non placent: have persecuted us, and please not God
et omnibus hominibus: and are adversaries to all men

QUI ETIAM DEDIT SPIRITUM SUUM: Who also hath given his Spirit
De caritate autem fraternitatis: But as touching the charity of brotherhood
we have no need to write to you.
Ipsi enim vos a Deo didicistis: for yourselves have learned of God

et operam detis ut quieti sitis,: that you use your endeavour to be quiet
vestrum negotium agatis et operemini man: that you do your own business, and work with your own hands, as we commanded you
et ut honeste ambuletis ad eos qui foris: and that you walk honestly towards them that are without; and that you want nothing of any man's.
NOLUMUS AUTEM: And we will not have you ignorant
vos ignorare fratres de dormientibus: brethren, concerning them that are asleep
